-- org_subscriptions: customPriceUsd int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE org_subscriptions MODIFY COLUMN customPriceUsd DECIMAL(10,2);

-- community_spaces: price int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE community_spaces MODIFY COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;

-- lms_courses: price, downPayment, installmentAmount int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE lms_courses
  MODIFY COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN down_payment DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN installment_amount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;

-- lms_pricing_options: price, downPayment, installmentAmount int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE lms_pricing_options
  MODIFY COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN down_payment DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN installment_amount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;

-- physical_products: price, compareAtPrice int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE physical_products
  MODIFY COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN compare_at_price DECIMAL(10,2);

-- digital_bundles: originalPrice, discountPrice int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE digital_bundles
  MODIFY COLUMN original_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN discount_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- physical_product_pricing_options: price, compareAtPrice int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE physical_product_pricing_options
  MODIFY COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  MODIFY COLUMN compare_at_price DECIMAL(10,2);

-- physical_product_orders: amountPaid int -> decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE physical_product_orders
  MODIFY COLUMN amount_paid DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- payout_requests: amountCents int -> amount decimal(10,2)
ALTER TABLE payout_requests
  CHANGE COLUMN amount_cents amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL;
